t2.title: Cars be banned from city centers
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should cars be banned from city centers?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
This is something I feel strongly about! Absolutely, live concerts are worth every penny and hassle.

Firstly, the energy of a live performance is incomparable. No recording can capture the feeling of thousands singing together, the vibration of bass through your chest, or the spontaneous moments artists create on stage.

Moreover, concerts create lasting memories. Years later, you remember where you were, who you were with, and how the music made you feel. These shared experiences are priceless.

However, I do understand the frustrations. Scalper prices, crowded venues, and poor organization can diminish the experience.

Nevertheless, for dedicated fans, seeing their favorite artist perform is irreplaceable. The connection between performer and audience is something streaming simply cannot provide.

My advice? Save up and go! You won't regret it.

Who's attending concerts this summer?
t2.sampleA1:
Hi!
I like cars. No ban. I go shop. Car good. Bus no good. Bye!
t2.sampleA2:
Hello,
I think cars are good. I have a car and I use it every day. I go to work and I go shopping with my car. It is easy. But the city center is very busy with cars and it is difficult to park. Maybe no cars is good for walking and the air. But I need my car!
t2.sampleB1:
Hello everyone,
I want to talk about cars in city centers. I think maybe we shouldn't ban them completely, but we should reduce the number of cars. It's true that cars cause pollution and traffic jams. For example, in my city, the traffic is terrible during rush hour.

However, for some people, cars are necessary. For example, people who live far away or people who need to transport heavy things. Also, businesses need cars for deliveries. So, maybe we can have a system where only certain cars are allowed, or we have a charge for driving in the city center. In my opinion, this would be a good compromise.
t2.sampleB2: Great question — this one always gets people fired up! Personally, I'm all for banning cars from city centres, or at least keeping them to a bare minimum. Anyone who's walked through a car-free square abroad knows how much nicer it feels: no fumes, no constant honking, and space for people rather than traffic jams, and the whole place just feels calmer. Shops and cafés tend to do better too, because folk actually stick around instead of rushing off to find parking. That said, I do get why some people are dead against it. Not everyone can hop on a bus, and businesses still need their deliveries. Elderly people and those with young kids can't just walk everywhere. So for me the answer isn't a blanket ban overnight. Cities should first sort out decent public transport, cycle lanes and proper delivery zones, then phase cars out gradually. That way nobody gets left behind. What do you all reckon? Has anyone here actually lived in a car-free city? I'd love to hear whether it lived up to the hype, or whether it caused more headaches than it solved. Fire away!
t2.uzSample:
Bu men juda qattiq his qiladigan narsa! Albatta, jonli konsertlar har bir tiyinga va tashvishga arziydi.

Birinchidan, jonli ijroning energiyasi beqiyos. Hech qanday yozuv minglab odamlarning birgalikda kuylash tuyg'usini, ko'kragingizdan o'tadigan basning tebranishini yoki san'atkorlarning sahnada yaratadigan kutilmagan lahzalarini aks ettira olmaydi.

Bundan tashqari, konsertlar uzoq muddatli xotiralarni yaratadi. Yillar o'tib, siz qayerda bo'lganingizni, kim bilan bo'lganingizni va musiqa sizga qanday ta'sir qilganini eslaysiz. Bu umumiy tajribalar bebaho.

Biroq, men umidsizliklarni tushunaman. Spekulyantlar narxlari, gavjum joylar va yomon tashkilotchilik tajribani kamaytirishi mumkin.

Shunga qaramay, sodiq muxlislar uchun sevimli san'atkorining chiqishini ko'rish o'rnini bosib bo'lmaydi. Ijrochi va tomoshabin o'rtasidagi bog'liqlikni striming hech qachon ta'minlay olmaydi.

Mening maslahatim? Pul yig'ing va boring! Afsus qilmaysiz.

Bu yozda kim konsertlarga boryapti?
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!
Menga mashinalar yoqadi. Taqiqlash yo'q. Men do'konga boraman. Mashina yaxshi. Avtobus yaxshi emas. Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom,
Menimcha, mashinalar yaxshi. Menda mashina bor va men undan har kuni foydalanaman. Men ishga boraman va mashinamda xarid qilaman. Bu oson. Lekin shahar markazi mashinalar bilan juda band va mashinani to'xtatish qiyin. Balki mashinalar yo'qligi piyoda yurish va havo uchun yaxshidir. Lekin menga mashinam kerak!
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hammaga salom,
Men shahar markazlaridagi mashinalar haqida gapirmoqchiman. O'ylaymanki, ularni butunlay taqiqlamasligimiz kerak, lekin mashinalar sonini kamaytirishimiz kerak. To'g'ri, mashinalar ifloslanish va tirbandlikka sabab bo'ladi. Misol uchun, mening shahrimda tirbandlik gavjum paytlarda juda yomon.

Lekin, ba'zi odamlar uchun mashinalar zarur. Misol uchun, uzoqda yashovchi odamlar yoki og'ir narsalarni tashishga muhtoj odamlar. Shuningdek, bizneslar yetkazib berish uchun mashinalarga muhtoj. Shunday qilib, ehtimol, faqat ma'lum mashinalarga ruxsat beriladigan tizimga ega bo'lishimiz mumkin, yoki shahar markazida haydash uchun to'lovimiz bo'lishi mumkin. Mening fikrimcha, bu yaxshi kelishuv bo'ladi.
t2.uzSampleB2:
Shahar markazlaridan avtomobillarni taqiqlash masalasi murakkab bo'lib, har ikki tomonning ham asosli dalillari mavjud. Piyodalar zonalarining ekologik va ijtimoiy foydalari inkor etib bo'lmasada, to'liq taqiq jiddiy kamchiliklarga olib kelishi mumkin.

Tarafdorlar haqli ravishda avtomobillar sonining kamayishi natijasida havo ifloslanishi, shovqin darajasi va tirbandlikning kamayishini ta'kidlashadi. Bu piyodalar va velosipedchilar uchun yanada qulay va xavfsiz muhit yaratadi, sog'lom turmush tarzini rag'batlantiradi va piyodalar oqimiga xizmat ko'rsatadigan mahalliy biznesni rivojlantiradi. Bundan tashqari, u jamoat transportidan va transportning muqobil turlaridan foydalanishni rag'batlantirishi mumkin.

Biroq, umumiy taqiq avtomobil transportiga bog'liq bo'lgan aholi va biznesga nomutanosib ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkin. Yetkazib berish, favqulodda xizmatlar va harakatlanishda muammolari bo'lgan shaxslar sezilarli qiyinchiliklarga duch kelishadi. Tiqilinchlik uchun to'lov, kam emissiyali zonalar yoki jamoat transporti infratuzilmasini yaxshilash kabi yanada nozik yondashuv ekologik muammolarni jamiyat ehtiyojlari bilan muvozanatlashtiradigan yanada amaliy yechim bo'lishi mumkin.

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who also attended. Write about your feelings and what you think the venue should do.
t11.sample: Hey! What a night! The performance was absolutely incredible! But seriously, those drink queues were ridiculous! They really need more bars. Still, best concert I've been to in ages! When's the next one?
t11.sampleA2:
Hi Kamron,
The concert was good! I liked the music. But it was very loud and I couldn't see very well. I think they need more chairs. See you later!
t11.sampleB1:
Hi Kamron,
Did you enjoy the concert last night? I thought the band was great, but the venue could be better. In my opinion, they need to organise the seating better because I couldn't see the stage properly. Also, it was very crowded. I think they should limit the number of tickets they sell. What did you think?
t11.sampleB2: Hey Kamron, What a night, right?! I'm still buzzing from that gig. The band smashed it, but honestly those drink queues drove me up the wall — the place really needs a few more bars. Other than that, best night out in ages! Let's do it again soon. Cheers, Bekzod Aliyev
t11.uzSample:
Salom!

Qanday ajoyib kecha bo'ldi-ya! Ijro mutlaqo ajoyib edi! Lekin jiddiy aytsam, ichimliklar uchun navbatlar juda ham uzun edi! Ularga ko'proq barlar kerak.

Shunga qaramay, so'nggi yillarda borgan eng yaxshi konsertim bo'ldi! Keyingisi qachon bo'ladi?
t11.uzSampleA2:
Salom Kamron,
Konsert yaxshi bo'ldi! Menga musiqa yoqdi. Lekin juda baland edi va men yaxshi ko'ra olmadim. O'ylashimcha, ularga ko'proq stullar kerak. Keyinroq ko'rishguncha!
t11.uzSampleB1:
Salom, Kamron,
Kecha konsert sizga yoqdimi? Menimcha, guruh ajoyib edi, lekin joy yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin edi. Mening fikrimcha, ular o'rindiqlarni yaxshiroq tashkil qilishlari kerak, chunki men sahnani yaxshi ko'ra olmadim. Bundan tashqari, juda gavjum edi. O'ylashimcha, ular sotadigan chiptalar sonini cheklashlari kerak. Siz nima deb o'ylaysiz?
t11.uzSampleB2:
Salom Kamron,
Kecha konsert haqida nima deb o'ylaysiz? Guruh ajoyib edi, lekin joyning o'zi haqida ba'zi e'tirozlarim bor. Atmosfera juda jonli bo'lsa-da, o'tirish tartibi ideal emas edi – ko'rsatuvning ko'p qismida ko'rinishim qisman to'silgan edi. Bundan tashqari, ichimliklar uchun navbatlar juda uzun edi. Menimcha, Metro Arena umumiy tashrif buyuruvchilar tajribasini yaxshilash uchun yaxshiroq ko'rish chiziqlari va qo'shimcha xizmat ko'rsatish punktlariga sarmoya kiritishni o'ylab ko'rishi kerak. Bu juda katta farq qilishi mumkin!

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the arena management. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample:
Dear Metro Arena Management,

Thank you for the opportunity to share my feedback on last night's event.

Firstly, the sound quality was exceptional. Every note was clear, even from the back rows. The lighting effects also significantly enhanced the atmosphere.

However, some aspects require attention. The queues at the bars were excessively long, causing many to miss parts of the show. Adding more service points would help.

Additionally, the parking facilities were inadequate. Finding a space took nearly thirty minutes. Clearer signage and more attendants would ease this issue.

Furthermore, offering mobile ordering for drinks could reduce queuing time.

Overall, it was a memorable evening and I look forward to future events.

Best wishes,
A Concert Enthusiast
t12.sampleA1:
Hi Metro Arena,


The music good. I like music. Seats ok. Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Dear Metro Arena,


I went to the concert. It was good, and the music was loud. But the line for drinks was long, and I was thirsty. I think you need more people for drinks. Thank you.


From, A Fan
t12.sampleB1:
Dear Metro Arena Management,


Thank you for asking about the concert. I went to the show last night and I have some opinions. The music was very good and I enjoyed the band. However, I think the lines for the bathroom were too long. Also, it was hard to find my seat because the signs were not very clear. In my opinion, you should have more signs and more bathrooms. Thank you for listening.


Sincerely,
A Concert Goer
t12.sampleB2: Dear Metro Arena Management, I am writing to provide some feedback on last night's concert, which on the whole I thoroughly enjoyed. To begin with, the sound quality was excellent and the visibility from my seat was spot on. The atmosphere was electric from start to finish, and it was clear a great deal of thought had gone into the production. That said, a couple of things let the evening down. The queues at the bars were painfully long, and many of us ended up missing part of the show. Taking on extra staff at peak times would make a real difference. The signage inside the venue was also rather confusing, so clearer directions would be much appreciated. Overall, it was a memorable evening, and with these small improvements I would happily attend future events. Yours faithfully, Dilnoza Karimova
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli "Metro Arena" rahbariyati,

Kecha bo'lib o'tgan tadbir bo'yicha o'z fikrlarimni bildirish imkoniyati uchun rahmat.

Avvalo, ovoz sifati juda yaxshi edi. Har bir nota, hatto orqa qatorlardan ham aniq eshitildi. Yoritish effektlari ham atmosferani sezilarli darajada yaxshiladi.

Biroq, ba'zi jihatlarga e'tibor qaratish kerak. Barlardagi navbatlar juda uzun bo'lib, ko'pchilik shouning bir qismini o'tkazib yuborishiga sabab bo'ldi. Ko'proq xizmat ko'rsatish nuqtalarini qo'shish yordam berishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, avtoturargoh imkoniyatlari yetarli emas edi. Joy topish deyarli o'ttiz daqiqa vaqt oldi. Aniqroq ko'rsatkichlar va ko'proq xodimlarning bo'lishi bu muammoni hal qilishga yordam beradi.

Qolaversa, ichimliklar uchun mobil buyurtma berish imkoniyatini taklif qilish navbatda turish vaqtini qisqartirishi mumkin.

Umuman olganda, bu unutilmas oqshom bo'ldi va men kelajakdagi tadbirlarni intiqlik bilan kutaman.

Eng yaxshi tilaklarim bilan,
Konsert ishqibozi
t12.uzSampleA1:
Salom, Metro Arena,


Musiqa yaxshi. Menga musiqa yoqadi. O'rindiqlar yaxshi. Xayr.
t12.uzSampleA2:
Hurmatli Metro Arena,


Men konsertga bordim. U yaxshi bo'ldi, va musiqa baland edi. Lekin ichimliklar uchun navbat uzun edi, va men chanqadim. Men o'ylaymanki, sizga ichimliklar uchun ko'proq odam kerak. Rahmat.


Sizdan, Bir Muhlis
t12.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli "Metro Arena" rahbariyati,


Konsert haqida so'raganingiz uchun rahmat. Men kecha kechqurun shouga bordim va menda ba'zi fikrlar bor. Musiqa juda yaxshi edi va menga guruh yoqdi. Biroq, menimcha, hojatxonaga navbatlar juda uzun edi. Bundan tashqari, o'rindiqni topish qiyin bo'ldi, chunki belgilar unchalik aniq emas edi. Mening fikrimcha, sizda ko'proq belgilar va ko'proq hojatxonalar bo'lishi kerak. Eshitganingiz uchun rahmat.


Hurmat bilan,
Konsertga tashrif buyuruvchi
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli "Metro Arena" rahbariyati,


Men kechagi konsertdagi so'nggi tajribam haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Umuman olganda, tadbir menga yoqdi, lekin yaxshilanishi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta sohalar bor.


Birinchidan, ovoz tizimi umuman yaxshi bo'lsa-da, bas haddan tashqari kuchli bo'lgan paytlar bo'ldi, bu esa vokallarni aniq eshitishni qiyinlashtirdi. Ehtimol, ovozni aralashtirishga ba'zi tuzatishlar kiritish foydali bo'lar edi.


Ikkinchidan, arenadagi shamollatish yetarli emasdek tuyuldi. Ayniqsa, chiqishning eng faol qismlarida juda dim bo'lib qoldi. Yaxshilangan shamollatish hamma uchun tajribani yanada qulayroq qiladi.


Nihoyat, menimcha, tashrif buyuruvchilar uchun oziq-ovqat variantlarining kengroq assortimentini taklif qilish qadrlanadi. Hozirgi tanlov biroz cheklangan edi. Takliflarimni ko'rib chiqqaningiz uchun tashakkur.


Hurmat bilan,
Doimiy tashrif buyuruvchi

What improvements would encourage you to attend more events?
